+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass
+class LoginRequest:
+    redirect_uri: str
+    provider_id: str
+    tenant_id: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class TokenExchangeResult:
+    access_token: str
+    id_token: Optional[str] = None
+    refresh_token: Optional[str] = None
+    expires_in: Optional[int] = None
+    token_type: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+def normalize_profile_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    name = claims.get("name") or claims.get("preferred_username") or claims.get("email")
+    return {
+        "subject": claims.get("sub"),
+        "email": claims.get("email"),
+        "email_verified": bool(claims.get("email_verified")),
+        "display_name": name,
+        "given_name": claims.get("given_name"),
+        "family_name": claims.get("family_name"),
+        "picture": claims.get("picture"),
+        "raw": claims,
+    }
+
+
+def normalize_audit_event(event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "event_type": event.get("event_type"),
+        "provider": event.get("provider"),
+        "subject": event.get("subject"),
+        "timestamp": event.get("timestamp"),
+        "details": event.get("details", {}),
+    }
+
+
+def coerce_scopes(scopes: Any) -> List[str]:
+    if scopes is None:
+        return []
+    if isinstance(scopes, str):
+        return [s for s in scopes.split() if s]
+    return [str(scope) for scope in scopes if scope]

+import hashlib
+import base64
+import secrets
+
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+
+
+def _b64url(data: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = load_identity_config(config)
+    code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    code_challenge = _b64url(hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode("ascii")).digest())
+    params = {
+        "client_id": config["client_id"],
+        "redirect_uri": payload["redirect_uri"],
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "scope": payload.get("scope", "openid email profile"),
+        "code_challenge": code_challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
